name: TNT Minecraft
description: Combine 9 TNT into one compressed TNT block. 10 tiers, each exactly 9x stronger than the last (up to ~3.5 billion times normal TNT). Set the fuse with the G key (1-3600 s) or a Clock and it explodes exactly on time; without a timer it behaves like vanilla TNT. High tiers detonate with a nuke-style area wipe. English + Persian.
